_about: Timetable patterns students rank. A combination gets the FIRST archetype whose every condition holds, so order matters and the last one must have no conditions. Conditions are {feature: {min, max}} (both optional, inclusive). Features are documented in app/fca/archetypes.py.

archetypes.label: All morning
archetypes.description: Nearly everything before lunch; afternoons free.

archetypes.label: All evening
archetypes.description: Nearly everything after lunch; mornings free.

archetypes.label: Compact 3-day week
archetypes.description: All classes packed into three days or fewer.

archetypes.label: Morning classes, evening labs
archetypes.description: Theory mostly before lunch, labs mostly after.

archetypes.label: Evening classes, morning labs
archetypes.description: Labs mostly before lunch, theory mostly after.

archetypes.label: Morning-heavy
archetypes.description: About two thirds or more of class time before lunch.

archetypes.label: Evening-heavy
archetypes.description: About two thirds or more of class time after lunch.

archetypes.label: Mixed
archetypes.description: Spread across mornings and evenings on every day.

secondary_score._about: Orders combinations inside one archetype. Lower is better. score = sum(weight * feature).
